About this home

Chapman Woods provides the beautiful backdrop for this delightful 1927 English Revival single-level residence. Meticulously maintained & upgraded for modern living & gracious entertaining, the home blends period character with today's amenities. Surrounded by a private walled garden, the landscaping was designed to offer serene patio & garden views from three sides. Enter through the front gate & be transported to a world of European elegance, complemented by a California-inspired drought-tolerant front garden. The home features double French doors from the dining room, kitchen & second bedroom--inviting indoor-outdoor enjoyment of the east patio & south-facing deck throughout the day. The living room is distinguished by dramatic 11-foot coved ceilings, a gas-log fireplace & multi-pane windows. An arched entry leads to the expansive dining room, complete with a skylight & additional seating area, flowing seamlessly to the east patio--perfect for alfresco dining. Hardwood floors grace many of the rooms. (Prior owner removed the closet in middle bedroom, adding built-ins, creating an inviting home office option with view to the deck; the closet could easily be restored. ) Enhancements include dual-pane Pella windows & doors, Hunter Douglas woven blinds, central A/C & custom built-ins. The cook's kitchen, with a bay window, offers high-end stainless-steel appliances plus a breakfast area with double doors opening to the outdoors. An oversized laundry room presents exciting possibilities--create a kitchen/family room, mudroom or design additional storage. The primary suite offers an oversized bathroom & closet. At the rear of the property, a separate bonus room with exposed-beam ceilings, new sliding doors & its own A/C wall unit offers endless flexibility--ideal as a wellness studio, creative space, home office or add a bathroom & create the perfect ADU, plus you still have a two-car garage, equipped with automatic opener + ready for EV installation. Home measurements: 2185 SF + 305 SF bonus room/studio (both taped). Tax Assessor shows 2162 SF. (Buyers to verify to their satisfaction. ) With enchanting curb appeal, generous proportions, rich architectural details & thoughtful upgrades, this home offers an opportunity to own a Pasadena Classic, just moments from the Caltech & San Marino neighborhoods + all that Pasadena has to offer. Love where you live. .. 3364 Yorkshire presents an easy place to enjoy privacy & a lock and go lifestyle!

No reason this house should not be sold by now. Previous buyer backed out, but by NO FAULT OF HOUSE. The value is evident once you enter! This is the desirable street of Yorkshire Road in Chapman Woods. It is a charming Tudor-style house with updated high-end Pella windows! Boasting 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, this residence sits on a generous lot spanning approximately 7,150 square feet. From the curb, take in the amazing fragrance of the spectacular hedge offering privacy and enveloping drought-resistant landscaping. Discover an inviting home with many French doors creating a seamless blend of indoor and outdoor living including brand name Trex decking. The main bathroom has been thoughtfully remodeled, showcasing modern fixtures and finishes. Natural light from the domed skylight bathes the formal dining area and dinner is served from the updated kitchen. Several noteworthy updates have been made such as; the roof was replaced in 2016. The plumbing and electrical wiring have been updated, offering modern reliability. The garage door was installed in 2012. The central AC system features a newer compressor installed in 2020, providing relief during warmer months. Also notable is the separate laundry room. The 2-car detached garage is EV-ready. The exercise/storage/office room adds valuable space for desired needs in today's lifestyle. This house in the Chapman Woods area of Pasadena offers an enticing blend of comfortable living, convenient location, and stylish updates. This is a great opportunity to make this charming residence your new home!
